label: Null degree of a perfection: Null: D is the represented degree of lacking a perfection altogether…
term: null degree of a perfection (lacking it altogether)
definition: null : D is the represented degree of lacking a perfection altogether, as no heat at all. Its only constraints are STMT-NO-DEGREE-BELOW-NULL (no represented degree is below it) and STMT-ABOVE-NULL-DEGREE-HAS-THE-PERFECTION (whatever stands strictly above it has the perfection). It is not a privation in the sense of a lacking that ought to be present, and it is not a measure of non-being: a being at the null degree of heat is simply not hot. Example: a stone at the null degree of life; counterexample: a mildly warm body, which is above the null degree of heat.
note: Stipulative analyst notion used to derive STMT-MORE-SUCH-HAS-THE-PERFECTION (what is hotter is hot) through degrees. Its application to esse (a being at the null degree of being) is not asserted: the derivation is per perfection and the premises are OPEN.
